instructions.name: handle
docs: Receive a cross‑chain message via Hyperlane.
In production, this would be invoked via CPI from Hyperlane's Mailbox.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: This function creates the SpokeState (global config) PDA.

instructions.name: new_intent
docs: The user "locks" funds (previously deposited) and creates an intent.
For simplicity, we assume full deposit has been made before.
NOTE: max_fee is not used now and we do not support amountOutMin yet for swaps.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Only the lighthouse or watchtower can call this.

instructions.name: update_igp
docs: new_igp_type contains either the IGP address (as in new_igp), or the overhead IGP address if the IGP is an overhead IGP.

errors.name: OnlyOwner
errors.msg: Only the contract owner can call this method.

errors.name: InvalidIntentStatus
errors.msg: Intent is in an invalid status for this operation.

errors.name: MultipleOrderAssets
errors.msg: Multiple input assets in a single order are not allowed.

errors.name: EmptyParams
errors.msg: Empty Params in new order function are not allowed

errors.name: IncorrectSettlementAccounts
errors.msg: Incorrect settlement accounts, mismatch with intent PDA.

types.name: SimulationReturnData
docs: NOTE: This is used for hyperlane interop only and should not be used anywhere else
which is a bug where if a simulated transaction's return data ends with zero byte(s),
they end up being incorrectly truncated.
As a workaround, we can (de)serialize data with a trailing non-zero byte.
